scope: Static readiness review only; no formal or pilot cell was launched by this review.

checks.evidence: Frozen 4 samples × 4 models expand to 16 unique IDs; no duplicate was found.

checks.requirement: Sample inputs are frozen and verifiable
checks.evidence: `run_matrix.py --check-only` reported `OK 4 samples x 4 models`; sample size and SHA-256 checks passed.

checks.requirement: Four prompt artifacts are frozen and hash-verified
checks.evidence: All four entries in freeze/MANIFEST.sha256 for prompts passed.

checks.requirement: Each model has frozen identity, architecture, snapshot, config hash, and inference config
checks.evidence: All four entries in freeze/models.json contain model_id, repo_id, architecture, model_class, snapshot_revision, config_sha256, quantization, runtime_backend, and inference_config.

checks.requirement: Endpoint identity is checked and recorded
checks.evidence: Runner queries /models, records active IDs, and can match repo_id or snapshot_revision; but there is no frozen expected endpoint identity and the fallback path is not yet covered by the frozen runner manifest.
No agent/session ID, fresh-session boolean, or fresh-session evidence field exists in cell RUN_RECORD.

checks.requirement: I2 model and endpoint identity are recorded
checks.evidence: model_id, repo_id, architecture, active endpoint models, and endpoint_identity_match are present; endpoint identity contract remains partial.

checks.requirement: I3 sample and prompt hashes are recorded
checks.evidence: Runner records prompt_sha256; sample hashes are verified before rendering; request.json preserves the effective payload.

checks.requirement: I4 no inherited cache/prefix reuse is proven
checks.evidence: No cache/prefix observation, counter, hit-rate, or isolation evidence is recorded; runtime_isolation is hardcoded to NOT ENFORCED BY THIS RUNNER.

checks.requirement: I5 reload or fresh-process isolation is proven
checks.evidence: No reload/fresh-process method, before/after model state, PID, timestamp, or backend lifecycle evidence is recorded.
Only created_at and elapsed_seconds are present; no explicit request start and finish timestamps are recorded.

checks.requirement: I7 no concurrent backend workload is proven
checks.evidence: No backend lock, workload probe, process/window audit, or exclusive-access assertion exists.

checks.requirement: I8 no Round-1 residue/transcript enters the cell
checks.evidence: Static source review shows the runner supplies only frozen sample material and does not import Round-1 artifacts; runtime independence is not separately proven.

checks.requirement: I9 no other cell state enters the cell
checks.evidence: No cross-cell contamination check, cache reset proof, or per-cell fresh-state assertion exists; all cells reuse the same runner and endpoint without isolation evidence.

checks.requirement: J1/J2/J3 raw adjudication material is retained without normalization
checks.evidence: Prompt, request, raw response, extracted final answer, model metadata, and hashes are retained; no normalization/stability conclusion is produced.
Required states FORMAL, PILOT_ONLY_NOT_FORMAL, INVALID_ISOLATION, RUNTIME_ERROR, and INCOMPLETE are absent.

checks.requirement: Formal runner is separated from pilot runner and pilot outputs
checks.evidence: The current run_matrix.py is the pilot runner; its working copy is modified relative to freeze/MANIFEST.sha256, and pilot outputs remain under runs/.
freeze/MANIFEST.sha256 expects run_matrix.py 4838f1cb08d879a353aa2f2ccb0d5d5f3db857c209e64736f37dba02028addb7, but working hash is c3b8f0423ff8a560006b34c88f8fd1621ea795d880c043c12c26f3a6032bd774.

checks.requirement: No formal runtime is launched by this review
checks.evidence: Review performed static file/hash/source inspection only.

critical_blockers: BLOCKER-1: runner provenance mismatch against frozen manifest;
BLOCKER-2: isolation schema I1/I4/I5/I7/I8/I9 is absent;
BLOCKER-3: formal status enum is absent;
BLOCKER-4: formal runner is not separated from pilot runner and pilot outputs.
nonblocking_gaps: endpoint identity contract should be frozen before execution;
explicit request start/finish timestamps should be added;
runtime no-Round-1-residue proof should be captured.

decision.next_permitted_step: Implement and freeze a separate formal runner satisfying the failed checks; then rerun this readiness review.
